text: Chidi - driving test Thurs @ 2pm, Mill Hill centre. 3rd attempt, v nervous, says he freezes at roundabouts + his instructor keeps telling him to stop overthinking. lesson the morning before, then mock test w/ his brother Emeka. text him good luck that morning, then ring afterwards. if he passes - cake?

gym 7am tmrw, then dentist 10.15 - don't forget retainer
